title: Implement Robust Logging Mechanism
description: This feature matters as it allows for better error tracking and debugging, implementing a logging mechanism that handles errors and edge cases, providing clear insights into application performance. It will enable logging of critical events, such as server errors and rate limiting incidents. This will significantly improve the overall production readiness of the framework.
testCases: Test logging of rate limiting incidents
acceptance: Logging mechanism should handle and log critical events without crashing the application, with clear and descriptive log messages
reason: To improve the overall reliability and maintainability of the yantraverse framework, a robust logging mechanism is essential for identifying and resolving issues in production environments
